title: And don’t forget to bring tissues! 😭 @Maybe Happy Ending the Musical ...
transcript: If you only see one new show from this Broadway season, I really hope it's this one. happy ending is a new musical that is playing at the Belasco Theater on Broadway. It tells the story of two robots that go on a road trip and fall in love. And using this very simple premise, it is able to ask deeper questions like, what does it mean to fall in love? And what does it mean to be human? And what starts as just a really cute ROM com ultimately turns into something so much deeper. A lot of the conversations around the show have been around the spectacle, and I absolutely agree that this is a gorgeous show to look at. But truthfully, I think where the show really shines is the actual show itself. Like, you could take the technical elements away and just do the show at music stands, and I think that you would still have an incredibly compelling piece of theater when that is funny and heartbreaking and thought provoking. I also wanna talk a little bit about the performances, cause you have two really great central performances from Darren Criss and Helen G Sheen. If you've been watching my page, you know that I am a massive Glee fan, so I was so excited to see Darren in this. And I've seen him in a lot of shows. I think he is the best he has ever been here. This role feels like It was written for him. Just what it requires, acting wise and vocal wise. It fits his sensitivities so well. And equally fantastic is Helen J. Chen in her Broadway debut. Helen has been a star on the rise for a while, and I am so excited to see her finally getting her big break. Similar to Darren, this is just a perfect showcase for her talents. And I really do think that in like, 10, 15 years, it's gonna be a major flex to be like I saw Helen Jensen and maybe happy ending, because she is going to be a massive star one day. So I think a combination of the material, the technical elements, and this cast make this particular production of Maybe Happy Ending a must see. And if you are someone who, like me, has been craving a new and original musical theater, then this is the show that you have been waiting for.
